title: src/db/pool.zig module doc-comment falsely states pg.zig is a stub
summary: The top-of-file module doc-comment in src/db/pool.zig states 'pg module is currently a stub'. This is false: pool.zig uses the real karlseguin/pg.zig library, all integration tests pass against a live PostgreSQL instance, and no code in pool.zig is a stub. The misleading comment causes confusion when reading the code and may lead developers to doubt the reliability of the pool implementation.

root_cause.details: The comment was accurate during the early scaffolding phase when pg.zig was not yet integrated. It was never removed after the real implementation was wired in.

prevention: Module-level doc-comments describing the state of dependencies should be removed or updated when the dependency is wired in, as part of the same commit.
